title: APIContractVersion
description: API contract version lock for xuansto-mcp-server. Defines current and minimum supported API versions.

changes: HookEngine plugin system for dynamic hook registration
Added decision_log, token_budget, project_init tools (16 total)
Progressive loading with phase-based resource preloading
Enhanced loading_progress action with feature availability and token budget tracking
Cumulative phase preloading (loads all resources up to target phase)
Phase history tracking with trigger information
Split agent_status into agent_status (query) and agent_manage (lifecycle) tools
Split knowledge_search into knowledge_search (retrieve) and knowledge_inject (inject/precipitate) tools
Added agent_manage, metrics_report, config_manage, knowledge_inject tools (20 total)
Added disclosure_transition action to resource_load_status with target_phase support
Backward compatible with v2.0.0 and v1.0.0 clients

major_version_match.description: Client major version matches server major version. Full feature set available.

min_supported_match.description: Client major version matches minimum supported version. Degraded feature set.

major_version_mismatch.description: Client major version does not match server or minimum supported. Incompatible.

breaking_changes_policy: Major version increments indicate breaking changes. Minor and patch versions are backward compatible.
deprecation_policy: Features deprecated in version N will be removed in version N+1 at the earliest.
